abstract: [ICLR 2025] CatVTON is a simple and efficient virtual try-on diffusion model with 1) Lightweight Network (899.06M parameters totally), 2) Parameter-Efficient Training (49.57M parameters trainable) and 3) Simplified Inference (< 8G VRAM for 1024X768 resolution).
